    SPiiPlus Platform

    The SPiiPlus Platform is an EtherCAT-based-control platform consisting of motion controllers, servo drives, interfaces, and I/O built to meet the needs of OEM engineering teams developing precision motion control systems.

    Learn More

    Products By Type

     

    SPiiPlus

    Motion Controllers

    High Performance, multi-axis EtherCAT motion controllers

     

    SPiiPlus

    Control Modules

    High performance, multi-axis EtherCAT motion controllers with integrated drives

     

    SPiiPlus

    Servo Drives

    Universal servo drives for any motor: linear, voice coil, brushless DC, brush DC & stepper

     

    SPiiPlus

    Interface & I/O Modules

    Plug & Play: Digital & analog I/O, laser control & drive interfaces

     

    Intelligent Drive Modules

    DS402 EtherCAT drives for high performance servo control

     

    Economical Control Modules

    High performance 1-4 axis motion controller with integrated drives

Into Motion

World-class partners in

Advanced Technology Innovations

Semiconductor Industry

ACS products control high-precision machines with sub-nanometer resolution that create the latest generation semiconductor chips in modern electronics.

Laser Processing

ACS products accurately control laser beams used in ultra-high precision thin film patterning, wafer scribing, cell phone glass cutting, and spot/seam welding applications.

DNA Sequencing

ACS offers a series of compact motion control universal drive modules for biomedical system designers who need flexibility and high throughput.

Electronics

ACS technology enables printed circuit board manufacturers to produce more, higher quality products faster, helping to lower the cost of consumer electronics
